chapter: Heroes, rivals and the drummers' craft
title: Sonny Greer's equipment and Gene Krupa's tympani
summary: Crouch and Crawford discuss how Greer's big set-up inspired other drummers to collect equipment.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Early drum kits and the gear drummers used

blocks.x: Do you think that Sonny had -- Sonny Greer's having so many --
-- that he kept having so many
instruments, do you think that affected a lot other drummers getting a lot of equipment?

Yeah, because I remember reading once Gene Krupa said that, when he first saw Duke's band and saw all this equipment that Sonny Greer had, he went and told his mother that he wanted to get a tympani or something, and she went out and got it.
